module: Split-screen telemetry tracker: split-screen sessions, usage duration of each configuration and multi-seat game modes played. splitScreenStarted and splitScreenStopped bracket a session in a level; the "splitScreenActive" activity restarts when the player count, layout or mode changes; "splitScreenGamemode" covers a multi-seat game mode.
notes: A start request (onSplitScreenStartRequested) is remembered for at most 300 s to document the origin of the start (entry, activity, fromMainMenu).
At the end of a round, only the result type (tie, presence of a winner) is reported, not player indices.
Game mode end reasons: restarted, switched, stopped, levelEnded, gameExit. Session end reasons: disabled, levelEnded, gameExit.
onExit and onExtensionUnloaded are the same function (closeAll).

onSplitScreenChanged.desc: Hook called when the split-screen configuration changes: starts/updates the session and activity, or ends them if disabled.

onSplitScreenStartRequested.desc: Hook called when the player requests split-screen start: remembers the origin.

onMultiseatGamemodeLaunched.desc: Hook called for each round started, including a restart from the end screen or the pause menu: ends the previous mode (restarted or switched) and starts the splitScreenGamemode activity.

onMultiseatGamemodeFinished.desc: Hook called at a round's end screen: emits splitScreenGamemodeFinished (tied, hasWinner).

onMultiseatGamemodeStopped.desc: Hook called when the game mode stops: ends the activity with the reason "stopped".

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload and synchronization with the current render_splitScreen configuration.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called when a level starts: resynchronizes the split-screen state.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level: closes game mode, activity and session (reason levelEnded).

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game exits: closes everything (reason gameExit).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: closes everything (same function as onExit).
